title: Spökjakt Archive
description: Searchable index of Swedish haunted locations investigated in the TV series Spökjakt (Joakim & Jonna Lundell, LaxTon Ghost Sweden, and team). Facts, witness reports, and folklore are kept separate.

LEGENDARY.label: Legendary
LEGENDARY.description: Most famous Spökjakt locations in Sweden — major viewer recognition and strong Haunted Sweden potential.

HIGH_PRIORITY.label: High priority
HIGH_PRIORITY.description: Strong paranormal reputation, historical weight, or high visitor interest.

DISCOVERY.label: Discovery
DISCOVERY.description: Lesser-known but compelling Swedish locations worth exploring on Haunted Sweden.

entries.shortDescription: Season 2 premiere — one of the world's most famous haunted houses, investigated alongside nearby Borgvattnets Vandrarhem.
entries.documentedHistory: 19th-century vicarage in Borgvattnet, Jämtland; decades of documented guest and staff reports. Part of a two-site cluster with Borgvattnets Vandrarhem (~200 m). Open for guided visits and overnight stays at the hostel.
entries.witnessReports: Decades of visitor and staff accounts: apparitions, voices, moving objects, temperature shifts. Spökjakt team documented reactions during overnight investigation.
entries.paranormalClaims: Widely described as among Sweden's most active haunted buildings; global paranormal tourism destination. Claims remain anecdotal — not scientifically verified.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Extremely long report history, international documentaries, and intense visitor experiences.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: Flagship trust anchor — pair with hostel entry on map cluster; ideal for Haunted Sweden verified investigation content.
entries.investigationHighlights: S2 Swedish premiere after COVID cancelled US plans; team also investigated Borgvattnets Vandrarhem in same episode; overnight equipment sessions.
entries.currentStatus: Active haunted tourism — guided visits and hostel accommodation.
entries.accessNotes: Booked visits and hostel stays; respect house rules.

entries.shortDescription: Roslagen manor where a historic séance table triggered one of Spökjakt's most intense nights.
entries.documentedHistory: Monumental herrgård at Österby bruk, Östhammar (Uppland); 18th-century ironworks estate linked to De Geer and Grill families. Managed as cultural heritage (Stiftelsen Österbybruks herrgård).
entries.witnessReports: Multiple witnesses warned the team about Tamms old séance table; owners and visitors describe long-term strange activity in the building.
entries.paranormalClaims: Episode reports escalated after Joakim invoked activity through the table; night described as spiralling out of control and investigation aborted. Interpretations vary — televised drama vs local belief.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Combination of séance folklore, witness warnings, and documented on-camera team distress.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: Top-tier storytelling revisit location (returned S6); strong manor category entry for Uppland.
entries.investigationHighlights: Infamous séance table session; team urged to stop; became recurring 'worst night' reference in later seasons.
entries.currentStatus: Heritage manor — public events and visits per foundation schedule.
entries.accessNotes: Check Stiftelsen Österbybruks herrgård for opening times and tours.

entries.shortDescription: Skåne castle hotel with centuries of estate history investigated in early Swedish Spökjakt season.
entries.documentedHistory: Näsbyholm estate near Skurup (Skåne); castle architecture and long aristocratic history; operates as hospitality and event venue.
entries.witnessReports: Hotel guests and staff traditions of unexplained sounds and presence in older wings (general estate folklore).
entries.paranormalClaims: Featured as classic 'Swedish haunted castle' episode; specific claims in broadcast should be treated as reported experiences, not proven.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Castle atmosphere plus hospitality ghost stories typical of Swedish manor tourism.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: Strong castle category; south Sweden balance to northern S2 sites.
entries.investigationHighlights: Overnight investigation in commercial castle setting; equipment sweeps of historic interiors.
entries.currentStatus: Active hotel and event venue — Näsby Slott / Näsbyholm.
entries.accessNotes: Book accommodation or events; respect hotel guests.

entries.shortDescription: Dramatic Skåne peninsula — caves, cliffs, and legends in an outdoor Spökjakt investigation.
entries.documentedHistory: Kullaberg nature reserve (Höganäs municipality); famous caves including Kullabergsgrottorna; lighthouse and Bronze Age heritage; protected coastal landscape.
entries.witnessReports: Hikers and locals describe unease in caves and misty trails; historical smuggling and accident folklore.
entries.paranormalClaims: Legends of lights, voices, and figures along cliffs; episode focused on outdoor night investigation rather than single building.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Landscape-scale folklore and extreme atmosphere — rare non-building Spökjakt format.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: Forest/Nature Site category; pairs with Skåne castle episodes for regional routes.
entries.investigationHighlights: Night exploration of trails and cave areas; drone-friendly coastal visuals.
entries.currentStatus: Public nature reserve — marked trails; cave access rules apply.
entries.accessNotes: Follow Naturvårdsverket rules; stay on trails after dark with proper gear.

entries.shortDescription: Historic monastery and royal residence in Skåne — religion, power, and monastery folklore.
entries.documentedHistory: Bäckaskog slott/kloster at Fjälkinge (Kristianstad); medieval Cistercian foundation, later royal estate; today heritage destination and event venue.
entries.witnessReports: Staff and visitors mention cold spots and presence feelings in older wings; monastery burial traditions.
entries.paranormalClaims: Ghost stories tied to monastic history and later aristocratic use; TV episode presented as haunted heritage site.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Deep religious history plus centuries of death and ritual on one estate.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: Church/estate crossover content; strong photography and guided tour access.
entries.investigationHighlights: Interior night investigation of monastery and castle rooms; historical context segments.
entries.currentStatus: Visitor destination — Bäckaskogs slott; guided tours and events.
entries.accessNotes: Check visitor opening hours; event bookings available.

entries.shortDescription: Värmland 'ghost farm' where many guests leave before midnight — explosive bookings after Spökjakt.
entries.documentedHistory: 1700s hembygdsgård in Skillingmark, Eda kommun; managed by Skillingmarks hembygdsförening since 1941 donation. Documented child deaths 1865 (diphtheria) — folklore differs on details.
entries.witnessReports: Guestbook decades of crying, furniture sounds, lights, figures at windows; staff report attic dread; many overnight guests abandon stay mid-night (SVT interviews).
entries.paranormalClaims: Legend of witch-execution ground beneath farm; 'death room' and moving rocking chair; Jocke & Jonna YouTube 2017 predates TV boom.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Extremely high guest dropout rate and national media coverage of overnight stays.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: LEGENDARY overnight case study; pair with S6 revisit entry.
entries.investigationHighlights: S2 season finale location before recap episode; established Frammegården as national ghost-house brand.
entries.currentStatus: Bookable overnight ghost stays (often fully booked seasons ahead).
entries.coordinatesNote: Skillingmark, near Skillingsfors — access via Spinnhjulet turnoff
entries.accessNotes: Book via Skillingmarks hembygdsförening; bring sleeping gear; May–October season typical.

entries.shortDescription: Season 3 premiere — iconic tuberculosis sanatorium with decaying wards and medical darkness.
entries.documentedHistory: Sanatorium founded 1910s at Målilla, Hultsfred (Småland); treated pulmonary patients until closure; later museum and heritage tours of preserved buildings.
entries.witnessReports: Visitors describe heaviness, sounds in corridors, and apparitions in ward folklore; museum guides share anecdotal accounts.
entries.paranormalClaims: Among Sweden's best-known abandoned medical sites; episode used decaying interiors for maximum atmosphere.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Death, isolation, and preserved hospital architecture create powerful emotional triggers.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: Abandoned/medical category flagship; high photography and documentary value.
entries.investigationHighlights: S3 opener with medium Serafia Andersson; equipment in long corridors and treatment rooms.
entries.currentStatus: Museum and guided heritage visits — Målilla sanatoriums museum.
entries.accessNotes: Book museum tours; respect preserved medical heritage.

entries.shortDescription: Skåne roadside inn with period rooms and innkeeper ghost folklore.
entries.documentedHistory: Traditional gästgiveri (coach inn) environment in Skåne; travel-stop heritage architecture and local rural history.
entries.witnessReports: Inn ghost stories from staff and guests — footsteps, knocking, presence in guest rooms.
entries.paranormalClaims: Classic Swedish inn haunting narrative; broadcast presented witness interviews and night recordings.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Inns combine death-on-the-road folklore with overnight guest experiences.
entries.investigationHighlights: Same premiere week as Målilla — dual release 25 June 2021.
entries.currentStatus: Historic inn — verify current operations before visiting.
entries.accessNotes: Contact venue for accommodation and access.

entries.shortDescription: Rural Swedish farmstead episode — isolation, outbuildings, and countryside folklore.
entries.documentedHistory: Historic farm environment (Stora Taksten/Takstens) in southern Sweden; generational rural settlement and agricultural buildings.
entries.witnessReports: Family and local stories of activity in main house and barns; typical Swedish farm ghost narratives.
entries.paranormalClaims: Episode explored classic 'haunted farm' tropes — night sounds, shadows in barns, generational tragedy folklore.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Farmsteads bundle family tragedy stories with isolated night acoustics.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: Discovery-tier manor/farm content; good for regional road-trip mapping.
entries.investigationHighlights: Barn and residential wing sweeps; Serafia Andersson medium sessions.
entries.currentStatus: Private farm — do not visit without permission.
entries.accessNotes: Private property; archive entry for TV reference only unless owner grants access.

entries.shortDescription: Swedish manor investigation with period interiors and aristocratic ghost lore.
entries.documentedHistory: Blombacka herrgård — country manor setting with 18th–19th century estate context (regional Småland/Blekinge border traditions).
entries.witnessReports: Manor staff and visitors describe figures in corridors and unexplained sounds in guest wings.
entries.paranormalClaims: Standard Swedish herrgård haunting package — white ladies, cold wings, night footsteps.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Manor architecture amplifies sound and shadow — reliable TV atmosphere.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: Manor/Estate category; good companion to Näsby and Österbybruk.
entries.investigationHighlights: Interior EVP focus; Johanna Öholm joined S3 cast.
entries.currentStatus: Verify current ownership and tour access before visiting.
entries.accessNotes: Contact property for access; may be private events venue.

entries.shortDescription: Island setting — isolation, water sounds, and Swedish archipelago ghost folklore.
entries.documentedHistory: Verkön island environment in the Stockholm archipelago tradition; seasonal residences and nautical access.
entries.witnessReports: Island isolation stories — boat access only, sounds carrying over water, empty summer houses.
entries.paranormalClaims: Episode used geographic isolation as horror device; local shadow and voice folklore.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Islands intensify vulnerability and auditory pareidolia at night.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: Unique island tag; connects Gothenburg–Stockholm coastal discovery route.
entries.investigationHighlights: Boat transport and night exterior sweeps; archipelago fog potential.
entries.currentStatus: Private island properties — no public access without owner consent.

entries.shortDescription: Värmdö castle — dramatic interiors and Stockholm archipelago accessibility.
entries.documentedHistory: Bogesunds slott on Värmdö; 19th-century castle built for Ulrik Sparre; today concerts, events, and guided visits.
entries.witnessReports: Event staff and visitors mention presence in towers and corridors; castle tourism ghost stories.
entries.paranormalClaims: TV investigation in tower rooms and great halls; claims remain folkloric.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Castle scale + event-staff anecdotes + easy access from Stockholm.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: High visitor access near capital; strong premium investigation visuals.
entries.investigationHighlights: S3 finale location before recap; castle tower focus.
entries.currentStatus: Active events castle — Bogesunds slott visitor program.
entries.accessNotes: Book tours and events via official castle channels.

entries.shortDescription: S6 return to the séance-table manor — team confronts unfinished business from 2020.
entries.documentedHistory: Same documented estate as S2 — Österby bruk herrgård heritage site.
entries.witnessReports: Prior witnesses and S2 cast reference ongoing unease around séance table and east wing.
entries.paranormalClaims: Revisit framed as answering whether prior demonic invocation followed the team; outcomes presented as inconclusive/reported.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Most emotionally referenced Swedish revisit in franchise history.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: Cross-season narrative for Haunted Sweden editorial and verified return mission.
entries.investigationHighlights: S6 'worst places' season; medium Pierre Hesselbrandt; direct callback to aborted S2 night.

entries.shortDescription: S6 return to Sweden's most famous bookable ghost house in Värmland.
entries.documentedHistory: Same Skillingmark hembygdsgård as S2; booking demand remains extremely high per regional press.
entries.witnessReports: Continued guestbook entries of mid-night departures; staff maintain attic is avoided.
entries.paranormalClaims: Revisit tested whether prior phenomena repeat for new cast/medium; claims unverified.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: National reputation + measurable guest abandonment behavior.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: Pair archive entries S2+S6 on future Frammegården place page.
entries.investigationHighlights: S6 episode between international returns; validates Frammegården as franchise pillar.
entries.currentStatus: Fully booked ghost overnights most seasons.

entries.shortDescription: Investigation at the Lundell family home — meta urban haunting and personal history.
entries.documentedHistory: Private residence linked to Joakim and Jonna Lundell; personal and family history rather than public heritage site.
entries.witnessReports: Family-reported unexplained activity referenced in series narrative; primary witnesses are residents.
entries.paranormalClaims: Episode explored whether phenomena follow people not buildings; interpretations symbolic vs literal.
entries.whyConsideredHaunted: Unique 'haunted home of the investigators' angle — rare in Swedish paranormal TV.
entries.hauntedSwedenPotential: Urban Legend category; ethical boundaries for public visitation (private).
entries.investigationHighlights: S6 penultimate episode; healer participation; personal objects and home rooms.
entries.currentStatus: Private home — not a public haunted tourism site.
entries.coordinatesNote: Approximate — greater Stockholm area; exact address not public
entries.accessNotes: No public access — archive documents TV investigation only.
